verdict.rationale: Asana ships built-in AI agents ('AI Teammates') and 'Asana Dash' described as an AI Chief of Staff that works inside real workflows with shared memory, governance, and Work-Graph context, plus an API to enumerate configured agents — this is a native, in-product AI assistant users can delegate work to, not just a third-party integration. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports validating real-world delegation experience and outcomes beyond first-party marketing/docs.
